name: Getac K120-EX G2-R
statusNote: Getac now lists the G3 generation in its place; it published no end-of-sale date.
summary: The Getac K120-EX G2-R is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 12.5-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro. It has been discontinued; the Getac K120-EX G3 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIB T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 3, checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIB T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Controlled environment with reduced pollution; protect from UV and strong mechanical impact; interfaces never used in hazardous areas; battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; not next to strong charge-generating processes; battery BP3S1P2100S-01 only.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Not itemised in the original certificate; datasheet lists rotating hand strap, shoulder strap, digitizer pen, DS100 dock, spare SSD kit. Chargers and adapters are not for hazardous areas.

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.ports: Thunderbolt 4, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, RJ45, HDMI 2.0, DC-in; optional serial/USB, barcode, smart card, HF RFID

strengths: Certified for ambient temperatures up to +60 °C
limitations: Discontinued; the Getac K120-EX G3 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
